description: A finished status report while three background agents work, with Claude Code's own right-aligned update notice ("✔ Update installed · /restart to apply") between the waiting line and the input box. The notice is the harness's chrome, not the agent's ask: no question, no /restart button, and the headline is the importer work. Synthetic.
